name: the cosmological rung
plain: A wager, not a measurement: that the universe's dark matter plays the part of carried precedent and its dark energy the part of the record. One observation could kill it.

carrier.state: precedent carried as classical bits (the dark-matter ROLE), receipts and append-only ledgers as the Record (dark energy's) (TIERS.md §4)

row.quote: ## 4. The cosmological rung — a wager, and the final remainder unmeasured

kill.text: DESI DR3: if it fires, the top rung's wager rows die in the stance and this rung inherits the death (TIERS_ARCHIVE_2026-09-26.md, 'The kill discipline travels with the import').

remainder: the Record itself, what no closed view carries; no instrument on this record measures it
not_claimed: It is not evidence about the sky (TIERS_ARCHIVE_2026-09-26.md). TIERS.md §5: no cosmological remainder is licensed.
